name: The Last Stochastic Technique (39-period stochastic 50-cross)
author: Encyclopedia of Technical Market Indicators study (via StockCharts)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
entry_long: Fast Stochastic (39) %K crosses above 50 AND close is above the previous week high close.
entry_short: %K(39) crosses below 50 and close < previous week lowest close.
exit: Sell/exit when %K crosses below 50 and close is below the previous week lowest close (stop-and-reverse).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: Optional: smooth %K with 3-period SMA (slow stochastic 39,1); OBV vs 30-day SMA confirmation; some stocks use 40/60 thresholds.
implementation_notes: Defined on daily chart; weekly window implementation must be fixed by implementer.
